evals.name: cinematic-dark-hero
evals.prompt: I'm launching Nocturne, an AI color-grading tool for indie filmmakers. Build me a cinematic, dark marketing site — the hero should feel like the opening titles of a film. Sections: hero, how it works (3 steps), a showcase of looks/grades, a couple of stats about render speed, testimonials from filmmakers, pricing (Free / Pro $24/mo / Studio $79/mo), FAQ, and a waitlist signup CTA. Next.js + Tailwind, ready to deploy on Vercel.
evals.expected_output: A build-clean Next.js site with a dark cinematic art direction (display serif, single accent, generative or imagery hero), staggered masked hero entrance, spring hovers, scroll reveals, reduced-motion support, a stat visualisation, and a scroll-linked polish layer.
assertions: Reduced motion explicitly handled in authored code
Distinct display + text fonts via next/font
A chromatic accent token is defined (--brand/--accent/--primary)
Reduced motion: all text visible after scrolling
Hero headline is large display type (>= 64px on desktop)

evals.name: bold-product-landing
evals.prompt: Make a bold, high-energy landing page for Relay — API monitoring for small dev teams (alerts in under 10 seconds, p95 latency dashboards, public status pages). It should feel loud and confident, not another bland SaaS page: big type, one strong color. Include charts showing latency improvement and uptime, a feature grid, an integrations logo strip, pricing, and a final signup CTA. Next.js + Tailwind, ready to ship on Vercel.
evals.expected_output: A build-clean Next.js landing page with loud display type, one strong accent, Bklit charts for latency/uptime revealed in view, Kokonut animated components, a bento feature grid, staggered reveals, spring hovers, reduced-motion support, and scroll polish.
assertions: Reduced motion explicitly handled in authored code
Distinct display + text fonts via next/font
A chromatic accent token is defined (--brand/--accent/--primary)
Reduced motion: all text visible after scrolling
Hero headline is large display type (>= 64px on desktop)
